steps.label: proposed
steps.note: Draft order from the service manual; a technician confirms, reorders or strikes steps. Step 1 is site-owned and is never generated.

items.text: Isolate and relieve pressure per the SITE procedure; verify zero pressure at the manifold.
items.label: unknown
items.source: site procedure (not in the manufacturer documents)

items.text: Remove the hex valve plugs (top discharge, bottom inlet). Examine the O-ring under each plug; replace if worn; lubricate new O-rings.
items.label: proposed

items.text: Remove each spring retainer by its tab; remove spring and valve; with reverse pliers remove the seat; remove the O-ring at the bottom of the chamber. Note: the 5CP6120 has an O-ring AND a backup ring on each seat.
items.label: proposed

items.text: Examine valve parts for pitting, gouges or wear; replace with the preassembled valve assemblies from the kits (two valve kits for a complete change). Immerse each new assembly in oil and push in until fully seated.
items.label: proposed

items.text: Remove the socket-head screws from the manifold head; rotate the crankshaft by hand to start separation; separate with two flat screwdrivers and light mallet taps, supporting the head. CAUTION: keep the manifold aligned with the ceramic plungers.
items.label: proposed

items.text: Remove the seal retainer from each plunger rod and examine for wear; examine each ceramic plunger for cracks or scoring (replace only if damaged).
items.label: proposed

items.text: With the crankcase side of the manifold facing up: remove the lo-pressure seal, the press-in seal case, its O-ring, and the hi-pressure seal (usually by hand).
items.label: proposed

items.text: Reassemble seals: lubricate each seal chamber; press the hi-pressure seal in grooved side down (metal back facing out); fit new seal-case O-rings; press each seal case in until seated. Service with the SAME seal type the pump was built with.
items.label: proposed

items.text: Install seal retainers (tab down, holes toward the manifold); rotate the crankshaft so the two outside plungers extend equally; lightly lubricate the plungers; slide the manifold head on, supporting from underneath.
items.label: proposed

items.text: Fit the manifold socket-head screws and torque to 115 in-lb (9.58 ft-lb, 13 Nm).
items.label: proposed
items.source: SM p.3 §5; torque chart SM p.6 'Manifold Screw M8'

items.text: Torque the valve plugs to 870 in-lb (72.5 ft-lb, 98 Nm).
items.label: proposed

items.text: Crankcase check: inspect oil seals and rear cover, drain plug and bubble gauge for leaks; check oil level and for water in oil; rotate the crankshaft by hand for smooth bearing movement.
items.label: proposed

items.text: Fill the crankcase to specification (17 oz / 0.50 l). Do not run the pump without oil.
items.label: proposed

items.text: Return to service per the site procedure; run and check for leaks at the manifold; confirm rated performance (7.4 gpm at 1725 rpm, 100–1500 psi).
items.label: proposed
items.source: site procedure + DS p.1 specifications; acceptance limits are site-defined (unknown)
